ideas.title: One-Dial Microwave

new_nodes.label: Single smart dial (press=start, turn=time), auto power
new_nodes.detail: One rotary encoder replaces timer + power knobs; power is chosen automatically by duration.

new_edges.from: Single smart dial (press=start, turn=time), auto power
Single smart dial (press=start, turn=time), auto power
Single smart dial (press=start, turn=time), auto power

ideas.rationale: One control with one meaning eliminates all learning curve for choosing time and power.

ideas.title: No Power Knob — Auto Power Logic

new_nodes.label: Infers power level from set duration
new_nodes.detail: Short times default to full power, long to lower duty-cycle — user never touches power.

new_nodes.label: Duration-based duty-cycle controller
new_nodes.detail: Simple RC/counter logic mapping time setting to on/off ratio.

new_edges.from: Infers power level from set duration

ideas.rationale: Removing a decision the user must make makes operation trivially simple.

ideas.title: Weight-Sensing Scale Cooking

new_nodes.label: Turntable load-cell weight sensor
new_nodes.detail: Cheap strain gauges under the cavity estimate food mass.

new_nodes.label: Auto-computes cook time from food weight
new_nodes.detail: Time = f(weight); user only places food and presses start.

new_edges.from: Auto-computes cook time from food weight

ideas.rationale: The microwave does the thinking: place food, press start, done.

ideas.title: Steam-Lid Done Sensor

new_nodes.label: Cavity humidity sensor
new_nodes.detail: Resistive humidity strip detects rising steam as food heats.

new_nodes.label: Stops cooking when steam output plateaus
new_nodes.detail: Humidity profile signals doneness; timer becomes a backup only.

new_edges.from: Stops cooking when steam output plateaus

ideas.rationale: Zero-guess cooking: the oven itself knows when food is done.

ideas.title: Ridiculous Big Button

new_nodes.label: Single oversized START button only
new_nodes.detail: 30-second auto-incrementing start button; pressing again adds 30 s.

ideas.rationale: One giant physical button is instantly understandable by anyone, including children and elderly.

ideas.title: Color-Ring Progress Dial

new_nodes.label: LED ring around the dial showing remaining time as shrinking arc
new_nodes.detail: Ambient color feedback replaces reading numbers: green→amber→red.

new_nodes.label: Glanceable progress feedback
new_nodes.detail: Communicates state from across the room without reading.

new_edges.from: LED ring around the dial showing remaining time as shrinking arc

ideas.rationale: Pictures-of-state beat numbers and text; no reading required.

ideas.title: Pictogram Food Buttons

new_nodes.label: Picture-buttons: mug, plate, pizza, milk, defrost
new_nodes.detail: Five embossed food icons with one-touch presets; no text, no numbers.

new_edges.from: Picture-buttons: mug, plate, pizza, milk, defrost
Picture-buttons: mug, plate, pizza, milk, defrost

ideas.rationale: Press the picture of what you have — no instructions ever needed.

ideas.title: Self-Describing Voice Microwave

new_nodes.label: Low-cost voice chip speaker
new_nodes.detail: Speaks simple prompts: 'Press big button to start', 'Food is hot'.

new_nodes.label: Audible guidance during operation
new_nodes.detail: Talks the user through the single interaction.

ideas.rationale: The microwave teaches itself in real time; nothing to learn.

ideas.title: Knob That Only Turns Right

new_nodes.label: Endless rotary encoder knob
new_nodes.detail: Turn right to add time in 15 s steps, press to start/cancel — replaces spring-return cam timer.

ideas.rationale: Turn-and-press feels like a stove knob but fixes sub-minute imprecision.

ideas.title: Bag-Clip Activation

new_nodes.label: Magnetic food-bag recognition latch
new_nodes.detail: Door closes magnetically with auto-start when a tag-carrying container is detected.

ideas.rationale: Shut the door, cooking begins — the interaction disappears entirely.

ideas.title: Disposable Timer Card

new_nodes.label: Pre-printed insert cards (milk 2 min, plate 1 min)
new_nodes.detail: User slides a printed card into a slot; the slot sets the time mechanically.

new_edges.from: Pre-printed insert cards (milk 2 min, plate 1 min)
Pre-printed insert cards (milk 2 min, plate 1 min)

ideas.rationale: The card carries the knowledge so the user doesn't need any.

ideas.title: Turntable-Free Stirrer Antenna

new_nodes.label: Rotating mode-stirrer fan in waveguide
new_nodes.detail: A spinning metal paddle randomizes the field so food heats evenly while standing still.

new_nodes.label: Even heating without moving the food
new_nodes.detail: Removes turntable, roller ring, coupler and motor.

new_edges.from: Even heating without moving the food

ideas.rationale: Flat floor means any dish fits and nothing needs aligning or spinning.

ideas.title: Ripple-Antenna Beam Steering

new_nodes.label: Fixed phase-shifted dual feed
new_nodes.detail: Two waveguide ports with offset phase wash out standing waves — no moving parts.

new_nodes.label: Field homogenization by interference
new_nodes.detail: Static optics replace mechanical rotation.

ideas.rationale: Fewer moving parts and no turntable wobble to worry about.

ideas.title: Bell Removed, Chime Free

new_nodes.label: Piezo buzzer on timer switch
new_nodes.detail: 20-cent piezo disc replaces mechanical bell striker and cam trip mechanism.

new_nodes.label: Electronic end-of-cycle ding
new_nodes.detail: Same audible alert, zero moving parts.

ideas.rationale: Cheaper, louder, unbreakable alert keeps operation familiar and simple.

ideas.title: Lamp-Free Glow Window

new_nodes.label: Electroluminescent door rim
new_nodes.detail: EL strip around the window glows when running — indicates status without illuminating food.

new_nodes.label: Status glow replaces interior lamp
new_nodes.detail: Never burns out, no bulb replacement.

ideas.rationale: Users mainly need to know it's running; a glowing ring tells them instantly.

ideas.title: Daylight Cavity — Transparent Oven

new_nodes.label: Fully transparent RF-shielded casing
new_nodes.detail: Transparent metal-mesh laminate (ITO/mesh glass) lets ambient light in; deletes lamp entirely.

ideas.rationale: See the food as if the oven weren't there — the simplest possible feedback.

ideas.title: Mirror Cavity

new_nodes.label: Polished stainless interior with angled mirror plate
new_nodes.detail: Metal reflector bounces exterior light through mesh so food is visible with no lamp.

new_edges.from: Polished stainless interior with angled mirror plate
Polished stainless interior with angled mirror plate

ideas.rationale: Free light from the room; one less part to fail or learn about.

ideas.title: Magnetron-Free Solid-State Core

new_nodes.label: GaN RF amplifier module (2.45 GHz)
new_nodes.detail: Low-voltage solid-state source deletes transformer, HV cap, diode and filament wear.

new_nodes.label: Gallium-nitride RF power amplification
new_nodes.detail: Semiconductor generation of microwaves from 48 V DC bus.

ideas.rationale: Instant-on, continuously variable power means no duty-cycle explanations for users.

ideas.title: Single-Cast Cavity

new_nodes.label: One-piece drawn stainless cavity shell
new_nodes.detail: Deep-drawn shell is cavity and wrapper in one — no seams, no spot welding.

new_nodes.label: Seamless wipe-clean interior
new_nodes.detail: No crevices for spills to hide in.

ideas.rationale: Fewer parts, lower cost, and the user's only maintenance task (cleaning) becomes trivial.

ideas.title: Dishwasher Door

new_nodes.label: Detachable dishwasher-safe door
new_nodes.detail: Door pops off like a refrigerator shelf and goes in the dishwasher.

new_nodes.label: Clean the greasiest part outside the oven
new_nodes.detail: Whole window assembly is submersible-safe with captive choke design.

new_edges.from: Clean the greasiest part outside the oven

ideas.rationale: One obvious gesture (pull the door off) replaces scrubbing technique.

ideas.title: Liner-Bag Cavity

new_nodes.label: Reusable silicone cavity liner
new_nodes.detail: Peel-out flexible liner; lift out, rinse, replace — never wipe the oven.

new_nodes.label: Remove spills by removing the liner
new_nodes.detail: Cleaning becomes handling, not scrubbing.

new_edges.from: Remove spills by removing the liner

ideas.rationale: The simplest cleaning action possible: take the dirty part out.

ideas.title: Waveguide-Integrated Splatter Guard

new_nodes.label: Angled self-draining waveguide port
new_nodes.detail: Mica sheet replaced by a sloped polished metal port where splatter rolls back into cavity.

new_nodes.label: Self-cleaning waveguide entry
new_nodes.detail: Deletes the mica cover part and its replacement problem.

ideas.rationale: Removes a part users are told never to remove — one less thing to understand.

ideas.title: Door With No Button

new_nodes.label: Piano-hinge gravity door
new_nodes.detail: Door drops open by gravity with damped hinge; push to close — deletes push button and latch lever.

new_nodes.label: Damped gravity hinge
new_nodes.detail: Friction damper gives controlled fall; magnets latch shut.

ideas.rationale: Push-to-open, push-to-close needs no explanation and no button to hunt for.

ideas.title: Cupboard Door Integration

new_nodes.label: Faceless oven for cabinet-door mounting
new_nodes.detail: Ovens hides behind a kitchen cabinet door; cabinet door IS the door.

new_nodes.label: Invisible appliance operation
new_nodes.detail: Opens and works exactly like the cupboard it lives in.

ideas.rationale: Users already know how to open a cupboard — the interaction is pre-learned.

ideas.title: Interlock-Free Slot Loader

new_nodes.label: Horizontal tray slot like a toaster
new_nodes.detail: Food tray slides in; RF path is only enabled when tray is fully seated — mechanical position is the interlock.

new_nodes.label: Load-and-go without a door
new_nodes.detail: Toaster-like interaction everyone already knows.

new_edges.from: Horizontal tray slot like a toaster

ideas.rationale: Toast a slice = reheat a meal: the mental model is borrowed, not learned.

ideas.title: Cooling By Stack, Not Fan

new_nodes.label: Bimetallic passive heat-spine fins
new_nodes.detail: Large passive finned heatsink replaces fan+motor — silent, zero power, no failure.

new_nodes.label: Passive convective cooling
new_nodes.detail: Chimney effect ducts heat out the top.

ideas.rationale: Fewer controls, less noise, and one less thing that can break.

ideas.title: Fuse-Label Cord

new_nodes.label: Resettable thermal plug fuse
new_nodes.detail: Self-resetting PTC in the plug replaces internal ceramic fuse — user just unplugs/replugs.

ideas.rationale: Recovery from a fault is an action everyone knows: unplug and plug back in.

ideas.title: One-Temperature Cook (Warm/Med/Hot by Touch Icons)

new_nodes.label: Three tactile dome buttons with braille-like bumps
new_nodes.detail: Warm / Hot / Defrost — outcome words instead of power percentages.

new_nodes.label: Outcome-based power selection
new_nodes.detail: Users choose the result, not the physics.

new_edges.from: Three tactile dome buttons with braille-like bumps

ideas.rationale: Asking for the outcome instead of watts removes all technical translation effort.

ideas.title: Smartplug Brain

new_nodes.label: Dumb oven + scheduling smart plug
new_nodes.detail: All timing moved to a $5 smart plug; oven has one mechanical run switch.

new_nodes.label: Remote and preset control via plug
new_nodes.detail: User controls with phone or voice they already use.

new_edges.from: Remote and preset control via plug

ideas.rationale: Reuse interfaces users already mastered instead of building new ones.

ideas.title: Phone-Tap Recipe Ring

new_nodes.label: NFC tag ring on the fascia
new_nodes.detail: Tap food package (with NFC sticker) to the ring; it sets time and power.

new_nodes.label: Package-driven settings transfer
new_nodes.detail: Instructions migrate from the box to the oven automatically.

new_edges.from: NFC tag ring on the fascia

ideas.rationale: Reading cooking instructions is replaced by a single physical gesture.

ideas.title: QR-Cook Packages

new_nodes.label: In-oven barcode scanner
new_nodes.detail: Scan the package's barcode; cloud/common database supplies time & power.

new_nodes.label: Scan-to-cook
new_nodes.detail: Zero settings: scan, close, eat.

ideas.rationale: The one button is 'scan'; everything else is decided for you.

ideas.title: Loudness = Progress

new_nodes.label: Rising-tone hum modulator
new_nodes.detail: A soft tone that rises in pitch as cooking nears the end — audible from other rooms.

new_nodes.label: Ears-free progress tracking
new_nodes.detail: Know dinner status while in the garden.

ideas.rationale: Continuous ambient feedback removes the need to watch or remember.

ideas.title: Pulse-Count Time Language

new_nodes.label: Click-per-15-seconds detent dial
new_nodes.detail: Each click = 15 s of cooking; counting clicks IS setting time — purely mechanical logic.

new_nodes.label: Detented encoder with audio click
new_nodes.detail: Haptic+audio feedback per increment.

ideas.rationale: Blind users and everyone else set time by feel and sound, no display needed.

ideas.title: Lid-Twist Start

new_nodes.label: Turn-to-start cavity ring
new_nodes.detail: Twist the outer ring of the cavity rim like a jar lid to start; counter-twist to stop.

ideas.rationale: Jar-lid twisting is universal muscle memory.

ideas.title: Ice-Cube Defrost Gauge

new_nodes.label: Cavity-floor thermal-change sensor
new_nodes.detail: Detects the temperature plateau at 0 °C to stop defrost exactly when ice clears.

new_nodes.label: Auto-stop defrost at thaw point
new_nodes.detail: No power-level or time guessing for defrost.

ideas.rationale: Defrost — the hardest operation — becomes fully automatic.

ideas.title: Child-Lock By Height

new_nodes.label: Recessed top-mounted control island
new_nodes.detail: Controls sit on the roof, out of children's reach; no lock mode to remember to enable.

ideas.rationale: Safety by physics, not by a lock sequence users must learn.

ideas.title: Superheat Guard Pop

new_nodes.label: Cavity vibration sensor
new_nodes.detail: Hears pre-eruption micro-bubbling in liquids and cuts power with a warning tone.

new_nodes.label: Detects imminent eruptive boiling
new_nodes.detail: Stops before the mug explodes.

ideas.rationale: Removes the one hazard users must be 'taught' about — the oven handles it.

ideas.title: Bag-Pop Done Signal

new_nodes.label: Acoustic 'pop' listener
new_nodes.detail: Microphone counts popcorn pops and stops at the ideal interval — famously zero-input.

new_nodes.label: Listen-based doneness detection
new_nodes.detail: Press once, walk away, perfect popcorn.

ideas.rationale: One press, no timer, no burnt popcorn — the archetypal no-learning-curve interaction.

ideas.title: Kettle-Cord Swappable PSU

new_nodes.label: External universal brick power supply
new_nodes.detail: Region variants solved by swapping a kettle-style cord; internal HV stage on standardized DC.

new_nodes.label: Region-independent operation
new_nodes.detail: One oven worldwide, different cords.

ideas.rationale: Users move appliances between countries with a cord they already understand.

ideas.title: Cap-Free Design

new_nodes.label: Solid-state HV-free power stage
new_nodes.detail: Switch-mode supply operating below 60 V DC eliminates the lethal HV capacitor entirely.

new_nodes.label: Inherently safe internal voltages
new_nodes.detail: No stored lethal charge exists anywhere.

ideas.rationale: Safety that requires no warnings, labels, or user knowledge.

ideas.title: Bowl-Dock Charging Base

new_nodes.label: Bayonet bowl docking floor
new_nodes.detail: Food comes in a supplied docking bowl that clicks into place — no turntable, no roller ring.

new_nodes.label: Self-centering food placement
new_nodes.detail: Click = correctly placed = even heating.

ideas.rationale: The satisfying click tells users placement is right — no technique to learn.

ideas.title: Elapsed-Knob Return

new_nodes.label: Dial that spins back to zero visibly
new_nodes.detail: Motor-driven knob physically returns to zero as time elapses — the knob IS the countdown display.

new_nodes.label: Mechanical countdown display
new_nodes.detail: Remaining time readable from across the room with no screen.

new_edges.from: Dial that spins back to zero visibly

ideas.rationale: The control and the display are the same familiar object.

ideas.title: Steam-Vent Aroma Bell

new_nodes.label: Aroma vent with timed waft
new_nodes.detail: At end of cycle, vent briefly wafts food aroma outward — smell says 'ready'.

new_nodes.label: Olfactory completion signal
new_nodes.detail: Multisensory done-cue, no sound needed.

ideas.rationale: The most natural 'food is ready' signal of all: the smell itself.

ideas.title: Dumbbell Presets Under the Door

new_nodes.label: Flip-lever presets (like old stove burner dials)
new_nodes.detail: Three chunky flip levers: Mug / Plate / Frozen; flip and walk away.

new_nodes.label: Lever-based one-gesture cooking
new_nodes.detail: Stove-like levers users have used their whole lives.

new_edges.from: Flip-lever presets (like old stove burner dials)

ideas.rationale: Borrow the 100-year-old stove dial — the most pre-learned control in kitchens.

ideas.title: Remove the Power Knob Entirely

new_nodes.label: Fixed full-power single-level design
new_nodes.detail: Delete power knob and duty-cycle cam; reheating tasks work fine at full power.

new_nodes.label: One-level cooking
new_nodes.detail: Defrost handled by time, not power — plus pulsing stir prompt.

ideas.rationale: The cheapest simplification: a control that doesn't exist can't confuse anyone.

ideas.title: Self-Describing Cavity Decals

new_nodes.label: In-cavity pictogram placard (put food here, press big button)
new_nodes.detail: Embossed arrow on the floor pointing to a floor-mounted start button.

new_nodes.label: Contextual instruction at point of use
new_nodes.detail: Instructions appear exactly where the hands are.

new_edges.from: In-cavity pictogram placard (put food here, press big button)
Contextual instruction at point of use

ideas.rationale: The product explains itself at the exact moment and place of interaction.

ideas.title: Spring-Return Kill Cord

new_nodes.label: Magnetic panic strip on front edge
new_nodes.detail: Swipe anything metal (spoon, knife) along the strip to kill power instantly — replaces switch hunting.

new_edges.from: Magnetic panic strip on front edge
Magnetic panic strip on front edge

ideas.rationale: Stopping the oven is the emergency action that must need zero thought.

ideas.title: Paper-Wrap Cavity

new_nodes.label: Replaceable cardboard/foil-free liner cartridges
new_nodes.detail: Microwave-safe molded pulp liners inserted like coffee pods; dirty liner goes to compost.

new_nodes.label: Single-use cavity protection
new_nodes.detail: Never clean the oven at all.

ideas.rationale: Cleaning is replaced by discarding — no skill, no time.

ideas.title: Sun-Icon Cooking Clock

new_nodes.label: Analog sun-position time dial
new_nodes.detail: Rotate pointer to a sun→plate icon; big colored arc counts down like a kitchen egg timer.

new_nodes.label: Analogue-visual timing metaphor
new_nodes.detail: Reads like a clock face everyone already knows.

ideas.rationale: Mapping new controls onto clock-face knowledge transfers a lifetime of familiarity.

ideas.title: Door-as-Lid One-Hand Bowl

new_nodes.label: Supplied nesting bowl that IS the door insert
new_nodes.detail: Click bowl into door recess, close door, cooking starts with bowl still in place.

new_nodes.label: Carry-cook-serve with one vessel
new_nodes.detail: Bowl never leaves the door; no turntable alignment, no oven transfer.

new_edges.from: Supplied nesting bowl that IS the door insert

ideas.rationale: One gesture (close the door with food on it) replaces a five-step ritual.
